```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 08_hypothesis_testing_spider_sample_reflection
title: >
  One Spider-Man or three?
questions:
  - id: spider_sample_reflection
    type: free-response
    checkLabel: Save response
    prompt: >
      Before we calculate anything, what do you make of this result? Is a sample
      of three people with a mean of 189 milliseconds stronger evidence that the
      spider bites changed reaction times than one person scoring 189 milliseconds?
      Why or why not?
    explanation: >
      There isn't a single response to mark right or wrong here. If you think
      the sample is more convincing, try to pin down why: what happens to a
      mean when you average several scores, rather than taking just one? Keep
      your reasoning in mind as we work through the problem. The next section
      gives us the tools to compare the individual score and the sample mean
      more precisely.
```
